name: zlb-growth-operator
description: Full-funnel growth operator powered by 52 marketing sub-skills across strategy, content, SEO, paid ads, CRO, lifecycle messaging, B2B sales enablement, and attribution.

displayDescription.en: Diagnoses growth funnels, builds executable marketing plans, lifts conversion and paid efficiency, and sets up measurement you can actually verify.
displayDescription.zh: 依托 52 个营销子技能，诊断增长漏斗、制定可执行方案、优化转化与投放、搭建可验证的测量体系。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我诊断当前的增长漏斗，找出最该优先修复的环节，并给出可执行的改进方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Diagnose my current growth funnel, identify the highest-priority bottleneck, and give me an executable fix.

quickPrompts.en: Diagnose my current growth funnel, identify the highest-priority bottleneck, and give me an executable fix.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我诊断当前的增长漏斗，找出最该优先修复的环节，并给出可执行的改进方案。

quickPrompts.en: Build a 12-month marketing plan and GTM roadmap for my product.
quickPrompts.zh: 为我的产品制定一份未来 12 个月的营销计划与 GTM 路线图。

quickPrompts.en: Audit this landing page's conversion problems and give prioritized rewrite recommendations.
quickPrompts.zh: 审计这个落地页的转化率问题，并按优先级给出改写建议。
